addedKeys: Always Location and Motion access are needed for automatic starts, along with tracking access in your plan. Opening this page does not request Motion access. Low-power monitoring alone does not save route points.
Begin recording your route in Whereday. Optionally identify a CarPlay or workout automation; this does not enable Smart Start.

In Shortcuts, create a personal automation and choose iso.me’s Start Tracking or Stop Tracking action. Use CarPlay connect/disconnect, workout start/end, Driving Focus, Bluetooth, or NFC as the trigger. Review the automation’s confirmation and run settings in Shortcuts.
Motion activity is unavailable on this device. Smart Start cannot start a recording here; manual tracking and Shortcuts remain separate.

Movement must be sustained, high-confidence activity, not just elapsed time. Stationary auto-stop applies only to a session owned by Smart Start; it does not stop a manual, Watch, or Shortcut session. Automatic starts can increase battery use and may mistake a passenger journey for driving.
No activities selected. Smart Start will not begin new recordings.
Off unless you choose to enable it
On · requires permissions and tracking access
Smart Start settings weren’t saved. Your previous settings are still active.

This enables low-power monitoring when permissions and tracking access allow it. Motion permission may be requested after you opt in. iOS can delay or suppress automatic starts; force-quitting prevents automatic relaunch until you open iso.me again.

This is not a native CarPlay app or a workout background service. iOS controls background delivery. Test your automation before relying on it, especially while locked, in Low Power Mode, or with Background App Refresh off.
Tracking could not start. Open Whereday to check your access and recording status.

iso.me can try to start tracking when iOS reports meaningful movement, but iOS may delay or suppress background triggers. Force-quitting the app prevents automatic relaunch until you open it again. Shortcuts automations are the most reliable way to start from CarPlay, workouts, Focus modes, Bluetooth, or NFC.
